name: Apple Podcasts
author: Aurelien Navarre
description: Your latest Apple Podcasts episodes in the bar, with a built-in player, after signing in on the web player.

barWidget.description: Lists the latest episodes from your Apple Podcasts library and opens them in the browser.

schema.label: Episodes to show
schema.description: How many episodes the panel lists, 1 to 50.

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the list refreshes on its own.

schema.label: List
schema.description: Latest episodes from your library, or your Up Next queue.

schema.label: Started episodes first
schema.description: Pins every episode you have started, and the one playing, to the top of the list, most recently listened to first.

schema.label: Then order by
schema.description: How the rest of the list is ordered: by show (feed), newest first within each, or by date across shows.

schema.label: Keep finished episodes (days)
schema.description: How long a finished episode stays in the list, with a green check mark, before it only appears under Played.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: How large the panel's text reads: small, medium, large or xlarge (extra large).

schema.label: Skip back (seconds)
schema.description: How far the back button jumps. Apple's clients offer 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 or 90.

schema.label: Skip forward (seconds)
schema.description: How far the forward button jumps. Apple's clients offer 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 or 90.
